GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Signage & wayfinding

Entry signs, tenant directories and practical directions, repaired or updated with the building in mind.

THE BRIEF

We inspect and organise repairs or replacement for agreed commercial signage. A faded sign face, loose fixing and outdated tenant directory need different work. We confirm the content, dimensions, mounting surface and installation access before materials are ordered.

✺

THE WORK

Define what needs to change

  • The face is damaged or faded

    We inspect the sign face, edges, retained frame and fixings. The scope distinguishes a replacement panel from work to the supporting assembly or surrounding finish.

  • The information is out of date

    Tenant names, room directories and directional information are checked against the approved brief. We confirm wording and location before production rather than relying on an old sign as the only instruction.

  • Visitors or deliveries miss the route

    We review the intended approach, destination and existing signs with your manager. The work may involve a coordinated update to several signs rather than changing one isolated arrow.

THE WORK

Resolve artwork and materials before ordering

  • Brand and content

    We work from available artwork and brand files, checking text, dimensions, colours and the agreed finish. This provides a clear reference for replacements across more than one location.

  • Surface and fixing

    We assess the mounting surface, existing holes, support and exposure. The specification identifies retained fittings, new fixings and any local finish repair around the installation.

THE WORK

From an approved sign list to installation

  1. 01

    Survey and confirm

    We record the sign locations and dimensions, then settle the approved content and replacement boundaries with your representative.

  2. 02

    Prepare the installation

    We confirm materials, delivery, removal and access. Electrical signage and major changes are separately defined and coordinated where included.

  3. 03

    Install and review

    We check the installed wording, position, fixing and agreed appearance, including the local finish around replaced or removed items.

THE WORK

Fit the work around arrivals and trading

Entry signs and loading directions often sit beside busy routes. We discuss installation height, access equipment, pedestrian movement, deliveries and any temporary change to the route. The agreed schedule identifies when old signage is removed and the new information becomes available.

THE WORK

A quote built from the sign schedule

  • Production and installation

    Quantity, dimensions, materials, artwork preparation, mounting height and access affect the allowance. Reused supports and new work are clearly distinguished.

  • Completion record

    We record the agreed locations and completed items, with photographs where included. Separate building, electrical or other outstanding tasks remain identified.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Good to know.

Can the existing frame be kept?+

We inspect the retained frame, fixing and dimensions first. If it suits the proposed sign, the scope can identify a face replacement and any necessary local preparation separately.

Can directories and parking signs be updated together?+

Yes. An approved list of wording, locations and quantities allows the work to be organised together, with different materials or installation conditions identified per sign.

What artwork should we provide?+

Provide the current logo or brand files, proposed wording and any existing artwork. We confirm the usable format, dimensions, colour and finish before ordering the agreed replacements.

Can you match existing signs?+

We work from your existing artwork, brand files and site measurements. We confirm the proposed material, colour and finish before ordering or installing replacements.
